uber_scope.denominator: aggregate passenger hours / aggregate driver work hours, NOT driver-average f or 24-hour car time
uber_scope.identification: descriptive comparisons across drivers and periods, not randomized causal attribution
uber_scope.missing: Los Angeles and Seattle taxi F are NA, excluded rather than zero
uber_scope.disclosure: Uber supplied data; Krueger disclosed past Uber-commissioned work, no ongoing relationship reported

airbnb_search_scope.sample: Chicago search data September 2013 to September 2014; stays fewer than 8 nights
airbnb_search_scope.identification: static choice-model counterfactuals, NOT measured before-after policy rollout or randomized treatment
airbnb_search_scope.denominator: Accepted: all searchers; reject_given_contact: searchers who contact. Do not combine the overall 42% rejection statistic with the model table baseline.
airbnb_search_scope.limits: fixed search exposure, no dynamic market-clearing/price equilibrium response; original microdata unavailable here; author worked at Airbnb

airbnb_welfare2022.locator: AER 2022 pp1783-1785, model estimate for top ten cities in 2014
airbnb_welfare2022.identification: estimated short-run structural equilibrium counterfactual, not revenue or comprehensive social welfare
airbnb_welfare2022.limits: consumer benefit includes hotel travelers; excludes full long-run housing/labor/neighborhood externalities; older working-paper figures must not be mixed

airbnb_reported_online_experiment.locator: Haldar et al. 2024, section 3.1 final experiment, following Table 2
airbnb_reported_online_experiment.mechanism: Bookability Filter: reduce low-booking-probability map pins, alpha=1; baseline up to 18 pins without filtering
airbnb_reported_online_experiment.identification: authors report online randomized A/B experiment; not independently re-estimated here
airbnb_reported_online_experiment.limits: company-authored study; no user-level outcomes or booking counts supplied here; global booking-normalized lift, not 1.9 percentage points of occupancy or utilization. Other launched changes cannot be added arithmetically to this lift.
